note: Kindi way of working (LEADS.md Part J; kindi is AGPL, ideas only): STATIC expert placement, misses computed on the CPU in place, prefetch only on prompt chunks. kindi-static = --adapt-every 0 alone (no per-window swaps at decode; the tier stays at the profile's startup fill). kindi-static-tracecount = the same with data/expert-profile-pancake-tracecount.bin (tools/make_profile.py bench/prefetch/routing.bin --base data/expert-profile-pancake.bin --reorder --out ...: the ranking is the trace's per-layer share, which equals its global count rank because every layer has the same pick total, T-671 offline; IN-SAMPLE on the 2026-11-08 routing trace). kindi-stack = that plus STRATA_PF_AHEAD=1 (prompt prefetch of the next layer from the last chunk's routing; depth 2 NOT coded, shortlist head NOT coded, expert-union draft length not coded: the engine already prices windows by measured per-width cost). All four arms are exact by design (placement and scheduling only; the CPU/GPU expert split changes which kernel computes an expert, as in spec 116); drift_check true reads any text difference. Run: python3 tools/pancake/abtest.py bench/specs/126-kindi-style.json --tier screen. The profile file must be copied to the box (data/expert-profile-pancake-tracecount.bin, 197 KB) before the run.
